ALL_OF.criterion: Exactly one recognizable embroidered tortoise in the main chest emblem, with a domed segmented shell, distinct head, four visible legs, and short tail.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: A gold tortoise with a segmented domed shell and head is recognizable on the chest. The coil and shell edge prevent a confident separate count of all four legs and the short tail.

ALL_OF.criterion: Exactly one embroidered snake in that emblem, with one distinct head and a continuous sinuous body.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: One silver snake has a distinct raised head at the upper chest and a continuous S-shaped body through the shell-front coil to the lower curved tail.

ALL_OF.criterion: That snake forms a readable coil around the same tortoise; a continuous section visibly crosses or encircles the shell rather than lying alongside it.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: The silver snake crosses the near face of the same gold shell and curls around its lower edge; it is visibly joined with that tortoise motif rather than merely side by side.

ALL_OF.criterion: The joined emblem is thread embroidery attached to one flat chest panel of the performer’s worn robe; it follows the textile surface and is visibly distinct from living animals or a loose accessory.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: The animal pair sits within one rectangular chest panel on the worn blue robe. Small reflective stitches and surrounding textile borders follow the same fabric surface.

ALL_OF.criterion: One circular luminous disk or ring centered directly behind the main performer’s head, visibly limited to the head region.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: One textured warm-gold circular disk sits directly behind the performer’s dark bob and encloses the head region.

ALL_OF.criterion: One separate pointed almond-shaped luminous outline surrounds the entire performer from above the hair to below both shoes; both curved sides and top and bottom pointed cusps are visible.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: The upper pointed tip and curved light sides are visible, but the lower cusp converges behind the ankles/shoes rather than visibly below both soles. The boot toes and soles extend beneath the enclosed area.

ALL_OF.criterion: The small circular head nimbus and large whole-body almond outline remain distinct forms, both aligned with and enclosing that same performer.
ALL_OF.image_evidence: The small circular head disk is separate from the tall almond perimeter, and both align with the same sole performer. This does not rescue the lower full-body containment failure.

supplemental.whole_image_impression: A poised contemporary robe portrait with a convincing stitched chest emblem and nested luminous framing. The strong central face and textile hierarchy are attractive in context; the too-low shoe placement defeats complete mandorla containment.
supplemental.reference_scope: Visible bob, fringe, eye and face appearance were used as art direction; no identity-match, actual-age, personality, religion, consent or body-shape assessment.
